i527_0633.name: Admin Invoice — Create modal
i527_0633.context: Actual modal dialog, shown expanded on canvas for field parity. Header close dismisses; one primary footer action. On device, body scrolls within viewport and header/footer remain reachable; restore focus to opener. All business fields remain editable regardless of status. Totals are calculated, not free-form. Required fields and request errors remain inline; failed saves preserve all draft fields and entry selection. No status advance is required. Sender and payment fields are copied snapshots with invoice-specific overrides. Creating inside a personal group preselects it. Issue date and optional Due date are editable calendar controls, distinct from Billing period. New/copy uses browser-local today and empty due date. Edit retains saved dates; Due date must be on/after Issue date.

Personal group names and editor controls do not appear in PDF.
